$comment: Torchlit Sandstone (v2 src/game/lib/palette.js), the only place a colour literal may live. sRGB hex. Ramps run dark to light. Reservations: fire ramp for hazards and telegraphs only, gold for pickups only, curse teal for mummies only, steel for blades and spikes only, HERO_* for the hero only. LIGHT values are either hex or the name of a P colour. HERO_* starting values are sampled from docs/art/pip-concept.png; HERO_EYE and HERO_PUPIL (ticket 11) are the concept's eye whites and pupils. Ticket 11 moved HERO_HAT and HERO_HAT_BAND darker and greener so the hat reads olive under the warm key and torch, and HERO_COAT a little bluer, off STEEL_DARK.
